AB02-q01-e7soit: A dual system has one set of brake controls, not two pedals; it is two separate air systems.
Both halves are air systems on the vehicle, each with its own tanks, hoses and lines.
AB02-q02-r3fpon: The front axle is usually worked by the secondary system; the primary usually works the rear axle(s).
Both systems supply air to the trailer; the primary usually brakes the rear axle(s).
AB02-q03-4gmyb5: 55 psi is only the warning level; build at least 100 psi in both systems.
150 psi is the safety valve setting; you need at least 100 psi in both systems.
AB02-q04-l3vdt8: The other half cannot fully take over; front or rear brakes are weak and stops take longer.
The spring brakes do not lock at once; stop safely right away while you still have brakes.
AB02-q05-4unrbl: Stopping the compressor at cut-out is the governor's job, not the check valve's.
Releasing too-high pressure is the safety valve's job; the check valve lets air flow one way.
AB02-q06-qxwczd: Slack adjusters are checked in Step 5, the walk-around, not the engine compartment.
The low-air warning is tested in Step 7, inside the cab.
AB02-q07-bskh0z: Release the parking brakes, or the slack adjusters can't move; chock the wheels instead.
150 psi is the safety valve setting and plays no part in checking slack adjusters.
AB02-q08-yeutdb: ¼ inch is the minimum lining thickness; adjusters need adjusting at more than about 1 inch.
½ is the drum crack limit (friction area width); adjusters need adjusting at more than about 1 inch.
AB02-q09-vposzr: Leaking hoses matter, but out-of-adjustment brakes are the problem found most often.
Out-of-adjustment brakes, not tires, are the most common roadside inspection problem.
AB02-q10-33zih1: Hand-adjusting an automatic adjuster only hides the mechanical problem; get it to a repair facility.
An automatic adjuster out of adjustment signals a mechanical problem; it will not fix itself.
AB02-q11-08s6pj: Linings are the friction material; being made of it is normal.
Linings are supposed to press on the drum when braking; that is how they make friction.
AB02-q12-yunwn0: 1 inch is the slack adjuster movement limit, not the drum crack limit.
¼ inch is the minimum lining thickness; the crack limit is ½ the friction area width.
AB02-q13-6owrkh: 2 psi is the static limit for a single vehicle; the applied limit is 3 psi.
4 psi is the applied limit for a 2-vehicle combination; a single vehicle may lose 3 psi.
AB02-q14-glk6bt: 6 psi is the applied limit for 3 or more vehicles; 2 vehicles may lose 4 psi.
3 psi is the applied limit for a single vehicle; 2 vehicles may lose 4 psi.
AB02-q15-s0wkec: 4 psi applies only when both vehicles have air brakes; without trailer air brakes the limit is 3 psi.
6 psi is the applied limit for 3 or more vehicles with air brakes.
AB02-q16-8cqwp2: 6 psi is the applied limit for 3 or more; the static limit is 5 psi.
3 psi is the static limit for 2 vehicles; 3 or more may lose 5 psi.
AB02-q17-m54t1w: The engine must be off and the parking brake released, with the foot brake fully applied.
Refill timing is the pressure buildup check; the applied test holds the brake for 1 minute.
AB02-q18-q7i128: 45 psi is the top of the spring brake range; the warning must come on before 55 psi.
20 psi is the low end of the spring brake range; the warning must come on before 55 psi.
AB02-q19-okod55: 55–75 psi is the low-air warning range; the valves pop out at normally 20–45 psi.
85–100 psi is the dual system buildup range; the valves pop out at normally 20–45 psi.
AB02-q20-4q43cr: A bus with an emergency park brake tank is exactly where the drive-forward test is used.
A single vehicle with an isolated parking brake tank is the only vehicle this test is for.
AB02-q21-zoeckk: 50 to 90 psi in 3 minutes is for pre-1975 single systems; dual is 85 to 100 in 45 seconds.
100 to 125 psi is the governor's cut-in to cut-out band, not the buildup test.
AB02-q22-vd990q: Test the parking brake by pulling gently against it in a low gear, not by driving.
Pressing the pedal is not the parking brake test; pull gently against it in a low gear.
AB02-q23-wwgid3: Test at about 5 mph, not highway speed, and note pulling, unusual feel or delay.
The service brake test uses the brake pedal, applied firmly at about 5 mph.
AB02-q24-yfq9b1: Missing a ★ check or its limits is an automatic failure, not a small point loss.
You must demonstrate the check and state the limits yourself.
